description: Land Acquisition -  Uduwawala, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily focused on land acquisition matters. It contains a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for acquiring specific land parcels for a public purpose (building an entrance road for a water supply project). The document provides detailed descriptions of the land boundaries, extents, and neighboring property claims. While it mentions a government minister, the core content deals exclusively with land/property matters, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
